judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: This has Nox's town voice: an excitable mayor full of exclamation marks, 'Urchins' capitalised inconsistently, 'East of here', a shopkeeper's 'Ya need some new weapons and armor? This is the place!' and one-line townsfolk. The unpolished slips (a missing final period, the redundant 'located') feel like original 1999 text. The only odd note is 'A warrior in [Place]?', which addresses the player by class.
